description: Bulk-create clauses from an uploaded file. The content chooses the parser: a clauses.export JSON payload (version 1), including variants, metadata, and category names that are created when they do not exist yet, otherwise a CSV with slug, title, body, and tags headers. Existing clauses are never updated, only new ones created. The batch size is capped, and clauses beyond the organization's remaining capacity are reported as skipped instead of failing the import.

alternative.limitation: creates one clause per call from a JSON body; there is no bulk CSV import over JSON
